lines: Yuuko: Cute. Wrong type, right confidence. Fix the type, keep the confidence.
Yuuko: Science demands precision. Yours just failed peer review.
Yuuko: Even I have limits, and you just tested all of them.
Yuuko: That was not a proof. That was a wish with syntax.
Yuuko: Re-run the logic. I will wait. I am very good at waiting.
speaker: YUUKO
